info.description:
Gately Admin API 用于脚本与自动化批量管理。

认证：在Admin console的“API token”页创建令牌，请求头携带 `Authorization: Bearer gtl_xxxx`。

权限：每个令牌只拥有创建时勾选的权限，格式为 `<模块>:read` 或 `<模块>:write`，写权限包含读权限。账号、Two-factor authentication、令牌管理以及备份、恢复、重启、系统设置接口只能使用登录会话。

请求体使用 `Content-Type: application/json`，错误统一返回 `{"error": "说明"}`。

Modules turned off under "Settings → Modules" serve no API: their endpoints return 403 and no longer appear in the API docs of the running instance.

Request body `{"version": 3, "rules": [{"hostname": "app.example.com", "path": "", "service": "http://localhost:8080", "originRequest": {}}], "catchAll": "http_status:404", "syncDns": true}`. Returns 409 when `version` differs from the current version on Cloudflare. Only ingress is replaced; other fields of the remote config and the origin settings of the catch-all rule stay as they are, and running cloudflared picks up the change automatically. Results are in `dns`: `created`, `unchanged`, `conflict` (`existing` holds the existing record) or `failed` (`error` holds the reason).

Required permission: `cloudflared:write`.
